title: Nephrolepis Cordifolia 'Lemon Button Fern' Live Tropical Terrarium Plant 6cm
description: The Nephrolepis Cordifolia 'Lemon Button Fern' is a beautiful indoor tropical terrarium plant, perfect for adding a touch of greenery to any room. This fern thrives in a tropical climate and prefers loam soil with a neutral pH. With medium growth rate and medium watering needs, it is easy to care for and will bring a touch of nature into your home during the autumn, summer, and spring seasons. This 6cm fern, grown in the United Kingdom, is a lovely addition to any indoor space for those who enjoy the beauty of ferns.
